description: Shared dependency versions for all FitLog MFEs

notes.angular: All Angular packages MUST be the same version across shell and MFEs
notes.federation: Native Federation versions must match for proper module loading
notes.core: RxJS, tslib, zone.js should be consistent for shared runtime
notes.devDependencies: Build tools should match to ensure consistent builds

usage: Copy these exact versions to package.json of each new MFE
